full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a young couple standing close together on a city street beside a parked dark car. The man stands at the left in a light-toned suit jacket, white shirt, patterned tie, and brimmed hat. One hand appears tucked into his trouser pocket. His posture is upright but easy, and he looks into the camera with a serious, slightly furrowed expression. The woman stands at his right in a sleeveless, softly textured dress with a fitted upper body and a fuller skirt. Her dark hair is arranged in loose curls around her face. One arm rests lightly across the man's side, and she also looks straight toward the lens with a calm, guarded expression. The car occupies the middle and right background, its window frame, pale roof, and dark body forming horizontal bands behind them. Across the street, a row of older multi-story buildings shows repeated windows, projecting details, and dark ground-floor openings. A small passerby in a light top walks in the left distance, giving a measure of street activity without interrupting the couple. Daylight is even and relatively soft, so the faces remain visible without hard shadows; the deepest blacks collect in the doorway recesses, the car body, and the man's hat brim. Moderate grain and slight tonal softness keep the image photographic and unpolished. The couple fills most of the frame from head to below the waist, while the car and façades remain clearly present as context. Their direct gaze, close stance, and contrasting formal clothes turn an ordinary urban sidewalk into a poised, intimate portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片拍下一对年轻男女紧挨着站在城市街道上，旁边停着一辆深色汽车。男子在左，穿浅色西装外套、白衬衫、花纹领带和带檐礼帽，一只手似乎插在裤袋里。他站得端正但自然，以略微皱眉的严肃神情看向相机。女子站在右侧，穿无袖、有柔和纹理的连衣裙，上身合体、裙摆较宽。她的深发在脸旁卷曲，一只手臂轻轻搭在男子身侧，也平静而带一点防备地直视镜头。汽车占据中间和右侧背景，车窗框、浅色车顶和深色车身在两人身后形成水平带。街对面是一排旧多层楼房，重复的窗、凸出的构件和深暗底层入口都可见。左边远处有一名穿浅色上衣的路人走过，提示街道活动，却不打断两人。日光均匀且相对柔和，让脸部在没有硬影的情况下可辨；最深的黑色集中在门洞、车身与男子帽檐下。适中的颗粒和轻微灰调柔化保持照片未经修饰的质地。两人从头到腰下占据画面大部，车和立面仍清楚地作为语境存在。他们直接的目光、贴近的站姿和相互对照的正式衣着，把平常的城市人行道变成沉着、亲近的肖像。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white urban portrait photography with two or more figures integrated into a readable street setting. Favor direct, human-scale framing and soft daylight that preserves facial detail while letting recesses and dark clothing carry the deepest tones. Compose the near figures as a compact vertical group, then use a vehicle, wall, or repeated architectural lines as a steady horizontal backdrop. Expressions are natural and somewhat reserved; small gestures of proximity give the image its relational force. Keep background pedestrians and details smaller and quieter, yet legible enough to make the street feel inhabited. Grain, slightly softened midtones, and restrained contrast should suggest a real photographic print rather than a polished fashion image. The composition balances personal intimacy with social place, holding dignity and ordinary life in the same frame.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白城市肖像摄影把两人或多人融入可辨的街头环境。采用直接的人体尺度取景和柔和日光，保留脸部细节，同时让凹处与深色衣物承载最深灰阶。近处人物组成紧凑的竖向群体，车辆、墙体或重复建筑线条则成为稳定的横向背景。神情自然且略为克制，细小的靠近姿态赋予关系力量。背景路人与细节更小、更安静，但仍足够可辨，使街道有生活痕迹。颗粒、略柔的中间灰与节制反差应让图像像真实相纸，而非精修时装照。构图平衡私人亲密与社会场所，在同一画面保留尊严和日常生活。
theme_en: A black-and-white street portrait of a couple beside a parked car and old apartment buildings
theme_zh: 一对男女站在停靠的汽车与旧公寓楼前的黑白街头肖像
name: Gordon Parks
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
